publications: Only verified, completed publications are listed. Downloads are checked before saving.
noArtifacts: No completed artifacts are published yet.
automaticHelp: This browser will plan and submit plots after confirmed successful training. Closing or detaching disarms this follow-up without cancelling training.
importModulesHelp: Trusted Python modules or .py files to import before inference, plotting or export. These execute code in the approved runtime and must be available there. No modules are inferred from checkpoint metadata.
formatHelp: png, pdf, svg, eps, tiff. Only bounded verified PNGs can be previewed inline; other formats are downloads.
sourceHelp: Choose a published checkpoint explicitly. Cross-validation summaries cannot be used as model weights. No operation starts until you approve its persisted plan.
resultsHelp: Choose a run in Experiments. Exports use exact generation, size and SHA-256 identity.
noClassification: No published checkpoint classification is available.
classificationFailed: Checkpoint classifications could not be verified. Refresh artifacts.
unacknowledged: The request was not acknowledged. Verify the connection, then check status or retry this unchanged plan.
settingsError: Review the execution settings and source publication.
selectionRequired: Select a dataset and an explicit checkpoint generation first.
artifactsFailed: Artifacts could not be loaded. Verify the connection and refresh.
downloadRequested: Verified artifact download requested. Your browser controls where it is saved.
budget: This artifact exceeds the 64 MiB browser budget. Export with the CLI.
verificationFailed: Artifact verification failed or download was interrupted. No file was published.
